- Preferred delivery format for the subprocessor list (CSV vs spreadsheet)?

- Any specific sections of the VSQ you want prioritized (data access, encryption, incident response)?

3) Vendor security questionnaire — I created a shared answers doc and started filling sections 1–6 (program overview, data flows, encryption). Link: https://redwood.corp.secure/VSQ/ACME-5342 (shared only with your security team). We’ll continue populating the rest, target delivery for completed VSQ first pass: 10 business days from today.

PHI / BAA stance: Redwood does not seek to process PHI by default. We can support HIPAA customers under a BAA and have standard language/practices to do so — happy to discuss specifics if Acme needs a BAA.

Let us know if you need the subprocessor list in a different format or additional region detail (availability zones).
